Important Notice — Before You Continue

Netskope Client Log Analyzer · Community Diagnostic Tool

Third-Party Tool — No Netskope Affiliation

This is an independent, community-developed diagnostic tool. It was not developed by, endorsed by, or affiliated with Netskope, Inc. in any way. Netskope provides no support or warranty for this tool or its results.

Data Handling — Stays In Your Browser

All log data is processed entirely within your local browser. No diagnostic data, log content, or personally identifiable information is transmitted to any external server or third party. Files are parsed in-browser and never uploaded outside your device.

Sensitive Data Advisory

Netskope log bundles may contain usernames, IP addresses, hostnames, and network metadata. You are responsible for ensuring analysis of these logs complies with your organisation's data policies and applicable regulations (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, etc.).

No Warranty — Use At Your Own Risk

This tool is provided "as is," without warranty of any kind. Diagnostic output should be independently verified before making configuration or security decisions.
